quote.text: The gods do not exists, and even if they exist they do not trouble themselves about people, and we have nothing in common with them. The piety and devotion to the gods that the majority of people invoke is a lie devised by swindlers and con men and, if you can believe it, by legislators, to keep criminals in line by putting the fear of God into them.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood: Encourage children to question inherited beliefs—the reflection reminds us that while traditions provide comfort, independent thought and inner virtue are paramount for true understanding.
  • Parenthood: Teach the value of authenticity over external authority; by instilling a mindset of self-reliance, you help them grow into adults who seek truth beyond societal constructs.
  • Leadership: As a leader, challenge conventional wisdom and scrutinize established norms; allow reason and empathy to guide your decisions rather than fear or manipulation.
  • Leadership: Recognize that true influence arises from integrity and transparency—lead by example to foster a culture where truth is valued over convenient myths.
  • Product Management: In product management, question market dogmas and focus on genuine customer needs rather than relying on inflated narratives or manufactured hype.
  • Product Management: Cultivate a team environment that prizes innovation and honest inquiry—as Epictetus warns against the deceit of popular consensus, so must your strategy be rooted in reality and continuous improvement.
